notes: Mission, second-model and station variables from the NASA Space Apps 2026 resource list. Giovanni series: python pipeline/fetch_missions.py (needs an Earthdata token). Station series: python pipeline/fetch_open_resources.py. Files land in data/raw/missions/<id>/<region-id>.csv; then run python pipeline/build_missions.py. Regions with fewer than 20 complete years are skipped, never repaired. Mapping and units: data/raw/missions/MAPPING.md and OPEN_RESOURCES.md.

variables.definition: Rain and snow measured by the Global Precipitation Measurement mission's satellite constellation, calibrated with rain gauges.
variables.suitable_for: Observed rainfall from the GPM mission named in the challenge; checks the model's precipitation
variables.caution: The V07 monthly record ends in September 2025, so 2025 totals are incomplete and excluded.

variables.definition: Water flowing off the land surface into streams, estimated by the GLDAS land model named in the challenge.
variables.monthly_units: kg m-2 per 3 h (monthly mean of 3-hourly accumulations)
variables.suitable_for: Water-budget questions; pairs with evaporation and rainfall

variables.definition: Water returning to the air from soil, water and plants, estimated by the GLDAS land model.
variables.higher_means: more water returning to the air

variables.long_name: GLDAS Noah soil moisture, top 10 cm (v2.1)
variables.definition: Water held in the top 10 cm of soil, estimated by the GLDAS land model.
variables.suitable_for: Drying and wetting questions; second-model check on MERRA-2 soil wetness
variables.caution: Model estimate over land only; drought needs more than one variable.

variables.definition: Air temperature near the surface retrieved from the Atmospheric Infrared Sounder on NASA's Aqua satellite.
variables.suitable_for: Satellite check on the model's temperature trend
variables.caution: Record starts September 2002, so only about 23 complete years; Aqua is near the end of its mission.

variables.definition: Nitrogen dioxide in the lower atmosphere, a pollutant from traffic, industry and fires, measured by the OMI instrument named in the challenge.
variables.suitable_for: Air-quality questions; the atmosphere above cities
variables.caution: Daily product averaged to months; record 2004-10 to 2026-03, so about 21 complete years.

variables.definition: Monthly average air temperature measured at one long-record weather station inside the region.
variables.suitable_for: Ground truth for the model and satellite temperature trends
variables.caution: A single station, not an area average. Stations: De Bilt (western Europe), New Delhi Safdarjung (Indo-Gangetic Plain), Chattogram (Bengal delta).
variables.source: NOAA NCEI Global Summary of the Month v1.0 via Climate Data Online

variables.definition: Monthly rainfall measured by a rain gauge at one long-record weather station inside the region.
variables.suitable_for: Ground truth for the model and satellite rainfall trends
variables.caution: A single rain gauge, not an area average.
variables.source: NOAA NCEI Global Summary of the Month v1.0 via Climate Data Online

variables.long_name: NASA Ocean Biogeochemical Model total chlorophyll (R2017)
variables.definition: Chlorophyll in the sunlit upper ocean, a measure of phytoplankton, the base of the marine food web. Estimated by NASA's ocean biogeochemical model, which assimilates SeaWiFS and MODIS ocean-colour satellite data.
variables.suitable_for: Ocean productivity questions near river mouths and coasts, as in the SeaWiFS chlorophyll study on NASA's resource list
variables.caution: Shorter record than our usual 20-year rule: 1998-2015 gives 18 years, accepted for this variable only and flagged as a short series. Model output that assimilates satellite ocean colour, not a direct satellite measurement. Ocean only.
variables.instrument: NOBM (NASA GMAO ocean model assimilating SeaWiFS/MODIS ocean colour)

variables.long_name: NOAA OI SST v2 sea-surface temperature
variables.definition: Temperature of the ocean surface from satellite infrared measurements blended with ships and buoys.
variables.suitable_for: Ocean warming questions; El Niño region
variables.caution: Box average over ocean grid cells; the KNMI copy ends in January 2023.
variables.instrument: AVHRR satellite + in situ (NOAA OISST v2)
variables.source: KNMI Climate Explorer (Space Agency Partner resource), field sstoi_v2, box average

variables.definition: How green the land is, the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index measured by polar-orbiting satellites since 1981.
variables.caution: Sensor changes (AVHRR to VIIRS) can create steps in the record; check the time series for jumps.
variables.source: KNMI Climate Explorer (Space Agency Partner resource), field ndvi_noaa_05, box average

variables.definition: Rainfall estimated from microwave and infrared satellite observations by NOAA's CMORPH technique.
variables.suitable_for: Second satellite rainfall record to compare with GPM IMERG and the model
variables.caution: Satellite-only (raw) estimate, not gauge-corrected; record 1998 to mid-2025.
variables.source: KNMI Climate Explorer (Space Agency Partner resource), field cmorph_monthly, box average

variables.long_name: OMI aerosol optical depth at 500 nm (OMAERUV)
variables.definition: How much sunlight is blocked by particles in the air such as dust, smoke and pollution haze, measured by the OMI instrument on NASA's Aura satellite. 0 is perfectly clear; above 1 is very hazy.
variables.suitable_for: Air-quality, dust and smoke questions; the atmosphere above cities
variables.caution: Daily product averaged to months; record from October 2004, so about 21 complete years. Replaces MODIS aerosol, which Giovanni does not offer.
